Hippowdon

Ground

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Hippowdon is a Ground-type Heavyweight Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 300 kg. It evolves from Hippopotas. Its highest base stat is Defense (118), with a base stat total of 525.
